verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an Audiences feature that builds audiences on warehouse sources and activates or syncs them to downstream tools. Its Reverse ETL pipelines reach 200+ SaaS destinations, which covers the core of audience activation. Nothing in the evidence shows continuous sync cadence or near-real-time entry and exit of membership. Because audiences are built on warehouse sources, sync is likely scheduled rather than streaming. The near-real-time 'Live Events' feature is an adjacent debugging view and does not count toward this story. Missing for 10: evidence of continuous or near-real-time membership updates (entries and exits), named ad-platform and engagement-tool audience destinations, documented sync frequency or latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
